about: Defects found in High Society's own live copy (v1 clone of highsocietydispo.com, captured 2026-09-16), each re-checked against v1-source on 2026-10-24. The rebuild does NOT carry these over. qa/hs-parity.mjs treats a missing unit that matches a declaration as declared, not lost, and grades a unit that matches a correction in its corrected form. Hidden text (Bootstrap d-none rows, listed per page in crawl/hs/v1-pages.json mainHiddenLines, see tools/hidden-audit.py) is not graded at all: it is in the page source but not on screen. Every item is also listed for the client in docs/OPEN-DECISIONS.md.
